item.title: Jaren Jackson Jr. out for season
item.description: Utah Jazz center Jaren Jackson Jr. will undergo surgery to remove a localized pigmented villonodular synovitis (PVNS) growth in his left knee, effectively ending his 2025-26 season. The growth was discovered during a post-trade MRI following his acquisition from Memphis.
